objective: Use a few contiguous mapped areas with different real obstructions, then measure reconstruction under controlled damage with hidden clean references.
natural_class_scope: Tags confirmed on anchor photos only; extended frames need individual inspection. Shadows are nuisance appearance, not necessarily missing geometry.

evaluation_tracks.name: natural_obstructions
evaluation_tracks.truth: No clean target image for genuinely occluded or clipped pixels
evaluation_tracks.restriction: Never call donor agreement a measured correctness rate

evaluation_tracks.name: controlled_corruptions
evaluation_tracks.truth: Original visible static pixels sealed away before feature extraction/pose fitting/model selection
metrics: failure and abstention by corruption type and severity
evaluation_tracks.restriction: Synthetic damage is a restoration benchmark, not proof of real under-car correctness

evaluation_tracks.name: geometry_reference
evaluation_tracks.truth: Published camera poses can independently check registration
evaluation_tracks.status: Primary source verified; no image archive acquired and dataset-use terms not established from README

annotation_requirements: Select multiple spatially separated targets per area before scoring; nearby views are donors, never independent test samples.
Review ground, structures, movers, equipment, shadows, existing anonymization and saturation per selected frame.
Freeze mask sizes, positions and severities on eligible visible static surfaces; record pixel area and solid angle, not just equirectangular pixel percentage.
Keep target clean RGB inaccessible to matching, geometry, candidate selection and confidence gates. Blur/clipping tracks use only explicitly declared degraded inputs.
Retain natural obstructions on all inputs; never synthesize a clean under-car target from another viewpoint and call it exact truth.
Audit donor field-of-view and sampling density; label apparently unobservable locations without using target truth to choose outputs.
split_policy: These three areas are already development/train. Do not promote any sub-window to independent test. Existing frozen test collections remain sealed.
next_action: Verify and inspect the acquired areas, annotate additional targets, then implement deterministic corruption generation and input-isolation tests before new model tuning.
current_algorithm_scope: Existing code fits a road plane. Building facades, sky, equipment and moving objects require separate models/masks; never feed their matches into the road-plane fit.
